description: This Java class 'JsonPathMatcher' is part of the mockserver project, implementing JSON path matching logic for HTTP body content. It uses external libraries like Jackson, JsonPath, and Apache Commons Lang.

classes.name: JsonPathMatcher
classes.description: A matcher class that uses JSONPath expressions to match JSON content within HTTP bodies, with logging and error handling.

methods.name: JsonPathMatcher
methods.description: Constructor that compiles a JSONPath expression from the matcher string and logs errors if compilation fails.

methods.name: matches
methods.description: Determines if the given JSON string matches the JSONPath expression, with detailed logging of mismatches and errors.

methods.name: isBlank
methods.description: Checks if the matcher string is blank.

methods.name: fieldsExcludedFromEqualsAndHashCode
methods.description: Returns fields excluded from equals and hashCode methods, annotated with @JsonIgnore.
